definition: The amount of one quantity for each one unit of another quantity, such as dollars per hour or litres per minute.
The distance travelled per unit of time, so speed $=$ distance $\div$ time, in units such as km/h or m/s.
The total distance of a journey divided by the total time it takes, including any stops.
The mass per unit of volume, so density $=$ mass $\div$ volume, in units such as g/cm$^3$.
The rate for changing money from one currency into another, such as $1$ euro $= 1.6$ Canadian dollars.
